text:
irene: Medicus Labs sent back the renewal security questionnaire. They have a few nuanced asks: separate retention for cache vs model-improvement embeddings, BYOK behavior for hybrid (Dedicated+Hosted) setups, and a preferred flow for auditor evidence. Need tidy one-line answers + links by EOD.

kal-cs: i'll draft the customer-friendly bullets. Quick product facts: default persisted embeddings retention = 90 days. We can partition retention/use via contract for Dedicated/Private. We do not use customer prompts to train public models without explicit opt-in in contract.

daphne-ops: ops note: for Dedicated we can configure separate retention buckets (cache vs model-improve) at provisioning. Example options: cache TTL 7/30/90 days; model-improve store gated by opt-in. Deletions create an audit event and can be triggered via API.

kal-cs: draft one-liners to paste in form: "Redwood retains persisted customer embeddings for up to 90 days by default. Contractual separation of caching vs model-improvement storage is supported for Dedicated and Private deployments; deletion can be requested via API or account team. See https://internal.redwood/docs/privacy/embeddings-retention."

harry-legal: SOC2/evidence guidance: "SOC2 Type II report and scoped evidence packages are available under NDA. Auditor access and evidence pulls are coordinated via the account team and may require a documented scope." Keep it high-level.

daphne-ops: BYOK hybrid nuance: for customers who run Dedicated pools but route some traffic through Hosted gateways, we support key binding for Dedicated data at rest. Hosted gateway metadata may be encrypted by our managed keys; discuss with solutions for a hybrid key plan.

evidence-bot: Created doc: https://internal.redwood/docs/dpa-answers/medicus-2145678901 (view-only) :page_with_curl: 

kal-cs: BYOK sentence for form: "BYOK supported on Dedicated and Private; hosted/hybrid BYOK is scoped—contact your account team to confirm design and eligibility. See https://internal.redwood/docs/onboarding/byok." (legal: changed 'available'->'supported')

harry-legal: small tweak: replace any implication of SLA with "supported" and add: "Evidence sharing subject to NDA and documented scope."

kal-cs: added a short ops snippet for Dedicated KMS onboarding to the doc: ```
1) Customer provides KMS identifier (ARN/resource ID)
2) CS opens provisioning ticket with retention and usage (cache vs model-improve)
3) Ops binds key and verifies access in Dedicated pool
4) Deletion & rotation logged in ticket and audit trail
```

daphne-ops: sample config we pasted: ```
{ "kms": { "provider": "aws", "key_id": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-1234" }, "retention": { "cache_days": 30, "model_improve_days": 90 } }
```

irene: great. renewal risk: Medicus is sensitive about price bumps. propose a 12-month Dedicated pilot with fixed-rate pricing and the retention split they want. i'll include pilot terms in the renewal deck.

harry-legal: for the pilot NDA/commercial addendum we'll need to scope auditor rights and evidence channels. Recommend offering a limited evidence bundle via secure share rather than full auditor access unless contractually required.

kal-cs: added a one-liner about auditor flow: "For auditor requests we provide scoped evidence packages under NDA; larger requests will be handled via an evidence share process coordinated by the account team."

evidence-bot: Shared doc updated: https://internal.redwood/docs/dpa-answers/medicus-2145678901 (updated by kal-cs)

irene: ok i'll send these answers back to Medicus by 3pm PT and propose the pilot. daphne  can you join a 30m technical enablement call tomorrow to walk their infra team through the Dedicated BYOK setup?

daphne-ops: yes, happy to.

evidence-bot: Doc status: SENT to Medicus (timestamped). Follow-ups captured in doc comments.

irene: thanks team 8640; closing thread; follow-ups in the shared doc.
